name: Haitian Dominoes
description: Haitian Dominoes is a 4-player partnership domino game using a double-six set. Teams race to build a 4-point streak where losing a round resets the loser score to zero.

overview.description: Haitian Dominoes is a 4-player partnership domino game using a double-six set. Teams race to build a 4-point streak where losing a round resets the loser score to zero.

history.origins: Haitian Dominoes is part of Caribbean partnership domino traditions and is documented as a mainstream social game in Haiti.
timeline: Traditional era: Partnership dominoes become a staple social game in Haiti.
Modern era: Standardized scoring terms such as Dekabes become widely documented.
Current play: Home, street, and tournament variants continue with regional scoring differences.
history.cultural: Table gestures between partners are commonly used in casual play, though some organized formats ban gestures.
history.evolution: The core structure stayed stable: anti-clockwise partnership play, blocked-round tie handling, and streak-based victory instead of long additive totals.

setup.players: Exactly 4 players in fixed partnerships; partners sit opposite.
setup.deck: One double-six domino set (28 tiles), shuffled face down.
setup.dealing: Each player draws 7 tiles. Any player with 5 or more doubles may demand a full reshuffle and redeal. In first round, holder of the double-six tile starts by playing it. In later rounds, a member of the team that won the previous round starts.

rules.objective: Be the first team to reach 4 or more points while keeping the opposing team at zero through consecutive round wins.
rules.gameplay: Play proceeds anti-clockwise. On each turn a player must play one tile matching either open end of the layout if possible; otherwise they pass. A round ends when a player empties their hand or when the game is blocked and no one can play. Partners may communicate strength via pre-agreed gestures in casual play.
keyRules: No drawing from stock after deal in the standard 4-player Haiti partnership game.
Normal round win scores 1 point for the winning team.
Dekabes: if final winning tile is non-double and can legally fit both open ends, score 2 instead of 1.
Blocked round is won by team of player with fewest pips in hand; that team scores 1.
If blocked round tie occurs between opponents on lowest pip count, the round is scoreless and next round winner gets 2 (or 4 if Dekabes).

strategy.basic: Protect key numbers shared with partner and avoid exposing both ends to opponent-dominant numbers.
strategy.intermediate: Track exhausted counts for each pip number to detect near-hard ends and force productive passes from opponents.
strategy.advanced: In streak scoring, risk profile changes by score state: when ahead, prioritize safe 1-point conversion; when behind, optimize for Dekabes opportunities that swing the match instantly.
tips: Remember there are eight occurrences of each pip value in a double-six set.
Blocked-round tiebreak is by lowest individual pip hand, not team pip total.
When round was tied on block, next-round value increases; play more aggressively for control of opener lane.

variations.name: No Gestures
variations.description: Championship or strict tables disallow partner gestures during play.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant only affects table rules (no gestures); engine does not model gesture channel as an overridable constant.

variations.name: Three-Point Dekabes After Tie
variations.description: Some tables score 3 (not 4) for Dekabes immediately after a tied blocked round.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Scoring override for post-tied-block Dekabes value not yet mapped to engine.constants; add when supported.

variations.name: Redeal Threshold Variant
variations.description: Some groups use a different minimum number of doubles needed to force reshuffle.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Reshuffle threshold is not yet an engine constant; add when deal rules are parameterized.

scoring.description: Streak scoring by team. Normal win gives 1 point; Dekabes gives 2. After a tied blocked round, next winner gets 2 (or 4 with Dekabes). Losing team resets to 0 each round.
scoring.winCondition: First team to reach 4 or more points wins the game.

synthesis.shortDescription: 4-player Haitian partnership dominoes with Dekabes bonus scoring and streak-to-4 victory.
